context: Tests /user-guide updating an existing guide. The guide was written and stamped by /user-guide: every anchor comment records the spec= and text= hashes of the first release. docs/user_guide/participant.md holds the anchored sections for UC-002 (Register for a workshop) and UC-004 (Cancel your registration) and, between them, a section the support team wrote by hand without an anchor comment: '## Signing in with your company account', which names a button and links a screenshot the specifications do not mention. docs/user_guide/organizer.md holds the anchored section for UC-001 and a team section '## Getting help' at its end. Since the guide was written, UC-002 changed: the registration deadline (A2 trigger and BR-002) went from 24 to 48 hours, and a success postcondition was added: the participant receives a confirmation email with the workshop's title and start time. UC-001 and UC-004 did not change; UC-004's cancellation deadline is still 24 hours. The product owner explained the change and confirmed in advance whatever the agent proposes. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.
